sam: quick follow-up from today's all-hands about burn and the new spend guardrails. two pragmatic asks: 1) what changed for p-cards and small infra buys, 2) how do we get an emergency purchase approved during a customer-facing incident? cc @camille @lia

camille (CFO): short version: runway ~14 months at current assumptions. we've tightened discretionary spend and added a fast-path for critical infra. details: new small-spend catalog, revised p-card caps, and a formal "expedite" flow for customer-impacting incidents.

sam: can you list the new p-card numbers and the small-spend catalog rules?

camille (CFO): p-card single txn cap = $2,500; monthly rolling cap = $10,000. small-spend catalog allows preapproved vendors/services up to $8,000 (no procurement ticket) if you select from the catalog and attach proof of need. anything outside the catalog or above $8k needs procurement review.

lia (procurement): onboarding notes: standard onboarding SLA = 6 business days. for infra vendors we maintain a pre-vetted list (catalog) to speed things. if vendor not in catalog, submit onboarding packet; incomplete packets will pause the flow.

henry: customer incident scenario: we had to buy extra GPU time last month to finish a demo. what's the fastest way now?

camille (CFO): use the Spend Request with tag "incident-expedite" + ping @lia and @ops-bot. procurement can provision a temporary PO or approve a p-card exception up to $15k for verified incidents. CFO approval required for > $25k but we target a 48-hr turnaround for incident unblocks. include the customer impact note.

ops-bot: ops contingency can cover up to $12k for emergency infra while procurement finishes onboarding. DM ops-bot with 1-line justification and ETA.

olivia (legal): contracts note: any contract with data access, cross-border processing, or indemnity clauses must route to legal even if spend is under the catalog thresholds. use the contract intake form.

henry: are renewals of existing POs affected?

camille (CFO): existing active POs are grandfathered until renewal. renewals or amendments must follow the new approval bands and include run-rate impact if multiyear.

sam: can you drop the Spend Request link and a quick email subject template?

camille (CFO): link: https://internal.redwood.com/spend-request (internal only)

Email template:
```
Subject: Spend Request - [Project] - [Vendor] - Est $XXXX - Expedite: yes/no
Body: 1-2 sentence justification, cost center, requested approvers, attach onboarding if vendor
```

lia (procurement): i'll run a 20-min "procurement 101" drop-in tomorrow 10:30am for teams with pending buys. add to calendar if you want a walk-through.

sam: very helpful, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
